title: Install and preflight Codex native task proposal review

requirement.summary: Build and hash the exact reviewed source, replace only the existing isolated AgentGov runtime, minimally enable the sixth proposal-review tool in the existing project Codex configuration, and validate the installed foreground protocol without an external replay.

objective.rationale: The source implementation and drift correction are complete; installed-runtime identity, sixth-tool visibility, and local protocol behavior must be proven before any separately authorized external replay.

goal: Install the exact Adapter 1.3.0 source into the existing pipx AgentGov environment, preserve the working absolute launcher, append only agentgov_task_proposal_review to the project tool allow-list, and complete local installed-runtime preflight.
non_goals: Do not start Codex, call the OpenAI service, send repository context externally, or claim a live replay.
Do not change AgentGov source behavior, weaken tests, rewrite existing project Codex settings, change the absolute launcher, or grant trust.
Do not install project dependencies, create another environment, modify another project, retain build artifacts in the repository, or require network access.
Do not implement a proposed task, touch NYC, create a session, commit, push, publish, release, deploy, or modify consumers.
acceptance_signals: A wheel built from the exact working source has a recorded SHA-256 and is installed only into the pre-existing pipx AgentGov environment without network access.
The installed foreground MCP server reports Adapter 1.3.0 and advertises six tools when form elicitation is negotiated; legacy initialization retains five tools.
The project Codex configuration preserves its existing absolute executable path and every existing setting, changing only the enabled_tools list to append agentgov_task_proposal_review.

Installed protocol preflight verifies the restricted elicitation schema, vendor-neutral result contract, compatible ignored response extensions, exclusive admit, and zero-write non-admission/failure behavior.
Task, scope, repository, documentation, and diff checks pass or report only explicitly preserved pre-existing exclusions; no external replay occurs.

items: Replacing the isolated runtime may fail if an AgentGov MCP launcher or child still holds the pipx environment lock.
Changing more than the single tool allow-list entry could break the working absolute launcher or alter Codex trust and approval behavior.
A source/install mismatch could create false live-readiness evidence unless the installed server version, schemas, and exact wheel hash are checked independently.
An accidental Codex launch would cross the separately controlled external-transmission boundary.

stop_conditions: Stop if the exact working source cannot be built offline and hashed or if the wheel identity cannot be tied to the current source.
Stop if installation would create a new environment, touch another project, require network access, or stop an unrelated process.
Stop if the existing project config differs beyond the known absolute launcher and five-tool allow-list or cannot be changed atomically by one appended tool name.
Stop on any installed version, discovery, schema, extension-compatibility, privacy, atomicity, task, scope, repository, or diff failure before declaring preflight complete.
Stop before starting Codex, external replay, implementation, Git writes, publication, release, or deployment.

decision.rationale: On 2026-08-07 the product owner explicitly approved exact-source build and hashing, replacement of the existing pipx runtime, the one-field project allow-list addition while preserving all other settings, and installed-only preflight without external replay.
